title: 第十三章 防患未然第十四章 任府凶案
content_zh:
;;
“除了养尸以外，那风水先生应该还精通幻术。”秦尧正色道：“因此我担心你们是中了他的幻术，误以为杀了他，实际上并没有。”
“你怎么知道他精通幻术？”四目疑惑问道。
“还记得彼时任婷婷为何推门而出吗？她说是因为房间内出现了好多蛇，然而当时房间内一条蛇都没有，否则不可能没留下丁点腥味。”
四目与九叔相互对视一眼，前者道：“师兄，要不我们再回去看一眼？”
九叔放下茶杯，起身道：“走吧。听到这里，不再去确定一下的话，这一夜都别想睡安生。”
“师弟，厉害啊！”瞪大双眼，望着他们匆匆离开的背影，秋生是真服气了，忍不住称赞。
“你指的是哪方面？”
“当然是你口舌如簧的本领啊，经你这么一吓，师父和师叔不仅不打你了，而且不管最终的结果如何，回来后都会夸你做事认真。”
“小了，格局小了。”秦尧叹道。
秋生：“？？？”
“问你个问题，你在遇到生死危机时，会不会将自己的看家本领使出来？”见他茫然不解，秦尧只能点拨道。
秋生神色一变：“我明白了，希望他只是在被杀时没来得及使出幻术……”
“感觉你这希望挺渺茫的。”秦尧道。
秋生：“……”
见他们的话题终结在此处，任婷婷趁机说道：“秦先生，能不能陪我出去走走？”
“不能。”秦尧果断拒绝。
“如果你肯答应的话，我就不缠着你换房间了。”
秦尧微微蹙眉：“最多一炷香的时间。”
“足够了。”任婷婷笑了笑，率先走出大堂。

今晚显然不是一个约会的好天气，但见乌云遮月，星光黯淡，勉勉强强能够看清脚下的道路。
任婷婷并未走远，离开义庄，避开他人眼目后，鼓起勇气：“你是看不上我吗？”
“不是看不上，而是儿女情长非我愿。”秦尧说。
任婷婷微微一怔：“真的？”
“如果你需要，我可以发誓。”
任婷婷目光一黯：“儿女情长非你所愿，那么你想要的是什么？功名利禄还是金银财宝？”
“比这再大一点。”
任婷婷沉默片刻，道：“若说志向，不提功名，我实在想不出还有什么。”
秦尧笑了笑：“只为长生！”
任婷婷愕然。
这是她耳熟能详却从未关注过的领域。
“为何要长生，活那么久真的有意思吗？”
“当然有意思，你无法想象，一百多年后的世界多么精彩，更别说一千年，乃至更多年后的世界。”秦尧道。
任婷婷：“……”
她确实无法想象，脑海中根本就没有相关概念。
秦尧瞥了她一眼，见她一脸呆萌的杵在原地，思绪不觉间飘远。

"In addition to raising corpses, Mr. Feng Shui should also be proficient in illusions." Qin Yao said seriously: "So I'm worried that you fell into his illusions and mistakenly thought you killed him, but in fact you didn't."
"How do you know he is proficient in illusions?" Simu asked in confusion.
"Do you still remember why Ren Tingting pushed the door open and walked out? She said it was because there were many snakes in the room. However, there was not a single snake in the room at that time, otherwise there would be no fishy smell left."
Simu and Uncle Jiu looked at each other, and the former said: "Senior brother, how about we go back and take a look?"
Uncle Jiu put down the teacup, stood up and said, "Let's go. If you don't confirm it after hearing this, you won't be able to sleep peacefully that night."
"Junior brother, that's amazing!" Qiu Sheng stared at their hurriedly leaving figures with wide eyes. Qiu Sheng was really convinced and couldn't help praising them.
"Which aspect are you referring to?"
"Of course it's your ability to talk eloquently. After you scared me like this, not only did master and uncle stop beating you, but regardless of the final result, they will praise you for your seriousness when you come back."
"It's too small, the layout is too small." Qin Yao sighed.
Qiu Sheng: "???"
"Let me ask you a question, when you encounter a life or death crisis, will you use your special skills?" Seeing his confusion, Qin Yao could only point out.
Qiu Sheng's expression changed: "I understand, I hope he just didn't have time to use the illusion when he was killed..."
"I feel like your hope is slim." Qin Yao said.
Qiu Sheng: "..."
Seeing that their topic ended here, Ren Tingting took the opportunity to say: "Mr. Qin, can you accompany me for a walk?"
"No." Qin Yao decisively refused.
"If you agree, I won't pester you to change rooms."
Qin Yao frowned slightly: "It takes at most one stick of incense."
"That's enough." Ren Tingting smiled and walked out of the lobby first.
Tonight was obviously not a good weather for a date, but seeing dark clouds covering the moon and dim stars, I could barely see the road under my feet.
Ren Tingting did not go far. After leaving Yizhuang and avoiding the eyes of others, she mustered up her courage and said, "Do you look down on me?"
"It's not that I don't like her, it's that my children's relationship is not what I want." Qin Yao said.
Ren Tingting was slightly startled: "Really?"
"I can swear if you want."
Ren Tingting's eyes darkened: "The love between your children is not what you want, so what do you want? Fame, wealth or gold and silver?"
"A little bigger than this."
Ren Tingting was silent for a moment and said: "If we talk about ambitions and don't mention fame, I really can't think of anything else."
Qin Yao smiled: "Just for immortality!"
Ren Tingting was stunned.
This was an area she was familiar with but had never paid attention to.
"Why live forever? Is it really interesting to live for such a long time?"
"Of course it's interesting. You can't imagine how wonderful the world will be in more than a hundred years, let alone the world in a thousand or more years." Qin Yao said.
Ren Tingting: "..."
She really couldn't imagine it, there was no relevant concept in her mind.
Qin Yao glanced at her and saw her frozen in place with a cute expression on her face, her thoughts drifting away unconsciously.
